title: Minimum XOR Value of Any Pair
description: Given an integer array `nums` containing at least two non-negative integers, find and return the minimum possible value of `nums[i] ^ nums[j]` over all distinct index pairs `0 <= i < j < nums.length`.
hints: For any three sorted integers `a <= b <= c`, consider the highest bit where `a` and `c` differ: `b` must agree with either `a` or `c` on that bit, so `min(a ^ b, b ^ c) <= a ^ c`.
Sort the array and take the minimum bitwise XOR over adjacent pairs `(nums[i], nums[i + 1])`.

examples.explanation: Pair (3, 5) has XOR 3 ^ 5 = 6, which is smaller than 9 ^ 5 = 12 and 9 ^ 3 = 10.
